hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))"); if echo "$FILE" | grep -q '\.env'; then echo 'Blocked: editing .env files requires manual confirmation'; exit 1; fi
FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))"); if [ -n "$FILE" ]; then npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
